notes: This contract pins the exact IEEE 1516.1-2025 C++ RTIambassador Auto Provide getter and the receive-order Send Interaction surface used by the standard federation-wide HLAsetSwitches MOM adjustment. The development profile returns the federation-wide value seeded from the creation FDD, accepts the standard four-byte HLAswitch enumerators through the MOM path, and exercises enabled/disabled discovery, callback-time switch mutation, receive-order and timestamped switch mutation before provider-callback admission, and re-enable behavior. The separately traced joined-federate HLAsetSwitches leaf does not broaden this Auto Provide claim. Other MOM control/reporting families, complete automatic provision, package evidence, protected review, JUnit promotion, and conformance remain open.
